Name: Polished Plate
Description: A perfectly polished piece of armor.

Name: Aegis Charm
Description: A protective charm that shields allies from fatal blows.
Ability 1 Desc: Once per turn: When an ally would die, they survive with 1 HP instead. [Target: NONE]

Name: Armor Aura
Description: An aura that hardens the resolve of allies.
Ability 1 Desc: At turn start, all allies gain 3 Armor.

Name: Awe Inspiring Totem
Description: At turn start, if there is a Tier 3 or Level 3 unit in the lineup, grants +1 HP and +1 PWR to all other lower tier and level units.

Name: Bargain Charm
Description: A charm that haggles for a better price.
Ability 1 Desc: Gacha draws cost 1 token less (minimum 1) once per machine, per turn. Valid for battles only. Player exclusive.

Name: Beginner's Charm
Description: Minigames: Gain 1 extra token if the mastery level of the answered flashcard is 1 (Very Hard).

Name: Burn Vial
Description: A vial of eternal flame.

Name: Hero's Catalyst
Description: Whenever an ally merges, grants +1 HP and +1 PWR to your Hero.
Ability 1 Desc: Grants the Hero +1 HP and +1 PWR on any merge.

Name: Fusion Spark
Description: A charm that weaponizes fusion.
Ability 1 Desc: Whenever a merge is performed on the battle board, deal 3 damage to a random enemy unit.

Name: Purifying Pendant
Description: When an ally takes damage from a negative status effect, removes all remaining stacks of that effect.

Name: Royal Insignia
Description: A medal signifying royal favor.
Ability 1 Desc: When a Level 1 unit enters the board, grant it +1 HP and +1 PWR.

Name: Rusty Ring
Description: Grants +1 HP and +1 PWR to all units with no equipment. Equipping an item cancels this buff.
Ability 1 Desc: Grants +1 HP and +1 PWR to all units with no equipment. Equipping an item cancels this buff.

Name: Soul Echo
Description: A mystical gem that echoes the souls of the fallen.
Ability 1 Desc: When an ally dies, resurrect the first non-hero unit that died this turn.

Name: Spiked Armor
Description: At turn start, the frontmost unit gains 2 Armor and 2 [color=#44CC44]Spikes[/color].
Ability 1 Desc: At turn start, the frontmost unit gains 2 Armor and 2 [color=#44CC44]Spikes[/color].

Name: Sprint Charm
Description: A charm that bends time.
Ability 1 Desc: Minigame timer gets a flat 2-second increase in battle.

Name: Token Return Charm
Description: A charm that reclaims spent potential.
Ability 1 Desc: The first unit to die each round returns tokens equivalent to its tier.

Name: Air Trait
Description: Enables the Air trait. Electrifies enemies with Static on attack, splashing charges that detonate into collateral damage upon death.
Ability 1 Desc: Air units electrify targets with Static on attack, splashing charges to adjacent enemies. [Target: NONE]

Name: Animal Trait
Description: Enables the Animal trait. Feral pack instincts empower an alpha and heal the pack with every fierce attack.
Ability 1 Desc: Grants +1 PWR to an alpha Animal pre-combat and heals Animals on every attack. [Target: NONE]

Name: Appliance Trait
Description: Enables the Appliance trait. Appliances inflict Static and Burn on attack, gain immunity and reflection against both, and convert incoming debuffs into raw stats.
Ability 1 Desc: Appliance attacks inflict Static and Burn. Grants immunity and pre-combat cleanse to both, reflects incoming status effects, and converts debuffs into stats. [Target: NONE]

Name: Costume Trait
Description: Enables the Costume trait. Masquerades in enemy strengths, stealing beneficial status effects and raw attributes before battle begins.
Ability 1 Desc: Pre-Combat: Steals beneficial status effects or base stats from mirrored enemies and enemy leaders. [Target: NONE]

Name: Earth Trait
Description: Enables the Earth trait. Grants Armor and Spikes across your frontline, turning impenetrable defense into devastating counter-attacks.
Ability 1 Desc: Grants Armor and Spikes to Earth units and allies, empowering Spikes to deal bonus damage on attack. [Target: NONE]

Name: Fighter Trait
Description: Enables the Fighter trait. Brawlers excel against high-health targets, cleaving enemies behind their mark and chain-attacking on kill.
Ability 1 Desc: Deals bonus damage against high-health targets, retaliates on attack damage, cleaves behind targets, and chains attacks on kill. [Target: NONE]

Name: Fire Trait
Description: Enables the Fire trait. Fire units ignite enemies on attack, spreading fiery destruction and dealing bonus damage against burning targets.
Ability 1 Desc: Empowers Fire units to burn enemies on attack, spread burns, and deal bonus damage to burning foes. [Target: NONE]

Name: Food Trait
Description: Enables the Food trait. Nourishes the ally standing directly behind when taking hits, passing down full power upon defeat.
Ability 1 Desc: Heals and empowers the ally directly behind when hurt, and passes down all PWR on death. [Target: NONE]

Name: Mecha Trait
Description: Enables the Mecha trait. Reinforced with armor and spikes, firing static laser salvos on merges and overloading upon destruction.
Ability 1 Desc: Grants Armor and Spikes, inflicts Static on attack, fires lasers on ally merges, and detonates retaliatory lasers on death. [Target: NONE]

Name: Plant Trait
Description: Enables the Plant trait. Deep roots foster spikes and steady regeneration, transforming healing into sharp thorn defenses.
Ability 1 Desc: Grants Spikes and HP pre-combat, and converts all incoming heals into Spikes. [Target: NONE]
Ability 2 Desc: At turn start, heals the lowest-HP Plant, and grants +1 Spikes and +1 HP to all Plants. [Target: NONE]

Name: Specialist Trait
Description: Enables the Specialist trait. Manipulates economy and gacha tokens, summoning combat clones and scaling power with accrued gold.
Ability 1 Desc: Ensures opening tokens, discounts gacha draws, earns gold on kill, and summons a combat clone to the bench. [Target: NONE]
Ability 2 Desc: At turn start, the frontmost Specialist gains +1 PWR per 5 Gold held. [Target: NONE]

Name: Support Trait
Description: Enables the Support trait. Inspires formation allies with bonus health and power, reinforcing the weakest units every turn.
Ability 1 Desc: Grants +1 HP to the ally ahead, +1 PWR to the ally behind, and +1 HP/+1 PWR to the Hero. [Target: NONE]
Ability 2 Desc: At turn start, grants +1 HP to lowest-HP ally and +1 PWR to lowest-PWR ally per living Support. [Target: NONE]

Name: Tank Trait
Description: Enables the Tank trait. Tanks bolster defensive armor, intercept attacks directed at backline allies, and convert armor into punishing spikes.
Ability 1 Desc: Grants Armor pre-combat, passes armor backward on absorption, intercepts attacks, and mirrors armor as spikes. [Target: NONE]
Ability 2 Desc: At turn start, grants 1 Armor to the frontmost Tank. [Target: NONE]

Name: Toy Trait
Description: Enables the Toy trait. Generates volatile static friction when struck in melee, culminating in an explosive static detonation on death.
Ability 1 Desc: Inflicts Static on melee attackers, and detonates the enemy with the most Static stacks on death. [Target: NONE]

Name: Water Trait
Description: Enables the Water trait. Flowing waves heal allies, cleanse debilitating negative effects, and convert afflictions into restorative energy.
Ability 1 Desc: Water units heal allies ahead and cleanse negative status effects pre-combat. [Target: NONE]
Ability 2 Desc: At turn start, heals lowest HP ally and converts negative statuses into healing. [Target: NONE]

Name: Trinity Charm
Description: If you draw at least once from each tier machine (1, 2, and 3) in a turn or encounter, gain 1 Token.
Ability 1 Desc: If you draw at least once from each tier machine (1, 2, and 3) in a turn or encounter, gain 1 Token.

Name: Twin Charm
Description: A mirrored charm that reflects its surroundings.
Ability 1 Desc: Your units gain +1 PWR for every 2 copies of that same unit in your battle pool.

Name: Underdog Emblem
Description: An emblem that protects the outnumbered.
Ability 1 Desc: At turn start, if your team has fewer units than the enemy, all allies gain 2 Armor for each unit difference.

Name: Vengeance Charm
Description: Channel the fury of fallen allies.
Ability 1 Desc: When an ally dies, grant +1 HP and +1 PWR to a random ally. [Target: RANDOM_ALLY]

Name: Veteran Insignia
Description: A badge of honor for seasoned warriors.
Ability 1 Desc: When a Level 2 unit enters the board, grant it +1 HP and +1 PWR.
